name: teamwork
description: Run several Claude Code sessions as a team on one goal. Sizes the team from the work's dependency graph rather than the goal's ambition, gives each member a lane it owns and a boundary enforced by a hook that denies an out-of-lane write, keeps work items in whatever tracker the project already has, parks the run at a point a fresh set of sessions resumes from, and improves its own rules from the friction they caused. Refuses to form a team when one session is the right answer, and keeps the contracts small enough to reload every turn by forbidding them to become a work log. Inside every session, on a team or not, runs the work as a crew of agents in roles the human approves, so the agent holding the plan does no part of the work and no agent checks its own.
